## 19.1 An outline first

- Ask for an **outline**, not for finished slides.
- A good prompt: **topic, audience, length, form, limit**.
- "5 slides, a title and 3 points of at most 8 words. Do not invent numbers
  or sources."
- No personal data in the prompt.

![A clear prompt gives a short outline.](images/outline-prompt.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Roles ("12 office staff"), never names and phone numbers.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Your outline"}
Write an outline prompt with the five parts for a 3-minute talk, get an
outline from an AI tool, and mark every number and source to check.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The prompt"}
Choose the part of the prompt.

::: {.match extra="the font|the file name"}
12 office staff, not technical
:   audience

5 slides, about 3 minutes
:   length

a title and 3 short points per slide
:   form

at most 8 words per point
:   limit
:::
:::

## 19.2 From the outline to slides

- **View › Outline**: paste the outline.
- A line at the left edge = a **new slide**. **Tab** = a point.
  **Shift+Tab** = a title again.
- Then a theme and the layouts. Copilot in PowerPoint can also make slides,
  if your account has it.

![Outline view.](images/outline-view.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/outline-lab.html" poster="sims/outline-lab.png" title="Outline Lab: from an AI outline to slides" height="1040" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Do not paste the whole answer onto one slide.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Paste and fix"}
Paste your outline into Outline view, fix the levels with Tab and
Shift+Tab, choose a theme, and save `my-ai-talk.pptx`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Outline view"}
Use Outline Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Ctrl+P|F5"}
Where is Outline view?
:   View › Outline

What does a line at the left edge become?
:   a new slide

Which key makes a line a point?
:   Tab

What is the real number of pages a month?
:   6,500
:::
:::

## 19.3 Pictures with AI, and checking them

- **Image prompt:** subject, style, setting, colours, shape (16:9), **no
  text**.
- Check: letters, hands, logos, details.
- No real people or brands. Alt text, and the note "AI-generated".
- A stock image or your own photo is often better.

![An image prompt in five parts.](images/image-prompt.png){width=100%}

![Errors in an AI picture.](images/ai-pictures.png){width=100%}

{{< sim file="sims/image-prompt-lab.html" poster="sims/image-prompt-lab.png" title="Image Prompt Lab: a picture for a slide" height="900" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Zoom in: errors hide in letters and hands.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · One picture"}
Write an image prompt for one slide, make and check the picture (or use a
stock image), and add alt text and the note "AI-generated".
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Pictures"}
Use Image Prompt Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="neon green|a famous singer"}
the shape for a picture next to the points
:   wide 16:9

the colours for the orange theme
:   orange and white

what to ask about text in the picture
:   no text

what to write for a screen reader
:   alt text
:::
:::

## 19.4 Check before you present

- **Facts and numbers:** your real data.
- **Sources:** open each; delete made-up ones.
- **Your words**, **few words**, and a short **note on the AI use**.

![Five checks.](images/check-deck.png){width=100%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A sure voice is not a true fact.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Lab task · Check your talk"}
Check `my-ai-talk.pptx` with the five checks, change at least one thing,
and add the note about the AI use.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Checks"}
Choose the check.

::: {.match extra="the theme|the transition"}
AI wrote 9,000 pages; the notes say 6,500
:   facts and numbers

“Green Office Report 2021” cannot be found
:   sources

five long sentences on one slide
:   few words

“Outline and pictures made with AI help”
:   the note on the AI use
:::
:::

## Game challenge: AI Deck Check {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Huda's talk "Going paperless" has a **wrong number**, a **made-up
source**, a picture with **wrong letters**, a prompt with **personal
data**, a slide with **too many words**, and needs a **note** about the AI
use.

{{< sim file="sims/ai-deck-check.html" poster="sims/ai-deck-check.png" title="AI Deck Check: ready for Monday?" kind="game" height="640" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The best action"}
Choose the best action.

::: {.match extra="keep it as it is|make the font smaller"}
a wrong number from the AI
:   correct it from the real data

a source that does not exist
:   delete it

“SUNRSIE CMOPANY” on a sign
:   a picture without text

staff phone numbers in the prompt
:   take out the personal data
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 6 · Prompts (harder)"}
Which prompt is better? Choose the reason.

::: {.match extra="it is longer|it is polite"}
“5 slides, 3 points each” or “a presentation”?
:   it gives the length and the form

“no text in the picture” or nothing?
:   AI writes wrong letters

“12 office staff” or the staff names?
:   no personal data

“Do not invent sources” or nothing?
:   fewer made-up sources
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Ask for an outline with topic, audience, length, form and limit.
- Outline view turns lines into slides; Tab makes points.
- Image prompts have five parts and ask for no text; check every picture.
- Check numbers and sources, use your words and few words.
- Say honestly what the AI did.
